Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

Alma, a Spring Health Company, is on a mission to simplify access to high-quality, affordable mental health care. We do this by making it easy and financially rewarding for therapists to accept insurance and offer in-network care. When a provider joins Alma, they gain access to a suite of tools that not only help them better run their business, but also grow it sustainably and develop as a provider. Alma is available in all 50 states, with over 20,000 therapists in our growing network. Anyone looking for a therapist can browse Alma’s free directory. Alma has raised $220.5M in funding from Insight Partners, Optum Ventures, Tusk Venture Partners, Primary Venture Partners, First Round Capital, Sound Ventures, BoxGroup, Cigna Ventures, and Rainfall Ventures. Alma was also named one of Inc’s Best Workplaces in 2022 and 2023.

Candidate Interview Guide

This role exists to build a growth engine. You will own the full performance marketing remit across our marketplace while refreshing the foundational martech, measurement, and creative systems that enable repeatable results. Leading and scaling acquisition through performance and external demand channels. You will be critical to helping Alma realize the vision of simplifying access to high-quality, affordable mental health care.

Reporting to the CPO, you will set and drive strategy, invest in growing the team, and drive measurable acquisition growth across our marketplace in a regulated environment. You will partner across Analytics, Product, cross-functional Marketing teams, Creative, and Finance to drive outcomes without channel cannibalization — and serve as a strategic thought partner to senior leadership on paid growth strategy and investment decisions. This is a high-impact role for a growth operator with deep performance marketing experience.

What you’ll do:

  • High-Scale Paid Acquisition
  • Scale the Engine: Own and expand the paid acquisition engine across SEM, paid social, programmatic/display, OLV/OTT, and affiliate channels, managing a significant annual marketing investment to drive incremental provider and client acquisition.
  • Strategic Roadmap: Define and execute a paid marketing roadmap with clear targets, KPIs, and ROI accountability.
  • Channel Innovation: Identify and unlock new platforms and tactics to ensure scalable, efficient growth beyond paid media, including partnerships, affiliate, and additional external demand sources.
  • Creative Partnership: Collaborate with Brand and Creative teams to accelerate testing velocity across message, audience, and assets.
  • Finance Partnership: Serve as the primary partner with Finance on growth planning, ensuring that acquisition targets, budgets, and payback are all aligned.
  • Marketplace & Lifecycle Integration
  • Marketplace Dynamics: Align patient and provider growth strategies to prevent channel cannibalization and unlock network effects.
  • Full Funnel Lifecycle: Oversee lifecycle channels across the full customer journey, ensuring the right message reaches patients and providers at the right time.
  • Product Synergy: Partner with Product and Engineering to build surfaces that optimize for conversion quality, not just top-of-funnel spend.
  • Martech, Measurement & Privacy
  • Infrastructure: Lead "build-vs-buy" decisions for martech and channel plumbing.
  • Advanced Attribution: Own the measurement framework, including incrementality testing, Media Mix Modeling (MMM), and reporting.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Establish measurement frameworks that operate strictly within HIPAA and federal/state data privacy constraints.
  • Cross-Functional & Team Leadership
  • Hire, mentor, and manage a high-performing, technical team across paid and organic
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to senior leadership on growth strategy, investment decisions, and marketplace dynamics

What you’ll bring:

  • 10+ years in performance marketing, demand generation, or growth marketing leadership, with a track record of scaling acquisition programs at significant spend levels, with experience hiring and leading growth marketing teams of 10+
  • Experience deploying AI-forward or AI-native marketing strategies and tooling
  • You’re a data-driven marketer with hands-on experience running structured experiments, A/B tests, and using insights to optimize campaigns and build repeatable playbooks
  • Familiarity with consumer growth dynamics
  • Experience leading a full-funnel strategy and exceeding goals
  • Strong martech and attribution expertise, including build-vs-buy decisions, incrementality testing, MMM, and privacy-preserving measurement approaches
  • Clear, direct communicator who can translate complex performance marketing topics for executives, boards, and non-expert stakeholders

Nice to have:

  • Track record operating in a regulated environment (healthcare, fintech, insurance, or similar) with working knowledge of HIPAA and evolving data privacy standards
  • Product-led growth experience
  • Familiarity with two-sided marketplace
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering and Product as one team with shared outcomes
  • Background scaling affiliate and partner marketing programs in consumer categories

The target base salary range for this position is $200,000 - $234,500

Benefits:

  • 401K plan (ADP)

Leidos is seeking a Senior Fire Protection Engineer (with expertise in Fire Life Safety) to join the National Airspace System Integration Support Contract (NISC) team.

The position will support numerous facets of the Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) Fire Life Safety Program, FLS Guidance, policy development, and planning. You will assist the Environmental Occupational Safety and Health (EOSH) Services Group to support and improve Fire Life Safety program elements intended to protect employees and others in the workplace and ensure compliance with Federal, State, and FAA laws and regulations.

This role is for someone with experience in Fire Life Safety/Fire Protection With their PE or wanting to become a PE.

Are you an EIT working to become a licensed Professional Engineer (PE)?

We can help you obtain that goal.

Remote position

Up to 50% travel within central US

Specific subject areas where services are needed include program management, training, Condition Risk Assessments (CRA) and Stairwell Pressurization Engine Generator (EG) replacement.

Senior Fire Protection EngineerPrimary Responsibilities:
In this role you will support numerous facets of the FAA's Fire Life Safety (FLS) Program, FLS Guidance, Policy Development, and Planning, specifically:

  • Provide final review for all CRA reports from Leidos and subcontractors before the reports are delivered to the customer.
  • Assist the FAA with the development of the Technical Implementation Guide.
  • Assist the FAA in fire investigations.
  • Maintain CRA templets and guides.
  • Maintain CRA SOP.
  • Maintain CRA tracking log.
  • Assist Leidos fire protection engineers and subcontractors during CRA report closeout meetings.
  • Work with the FAA to ensure the CRA reports contain the information requested by the FAA.
  • Assist in the hiring process of additional personnel.
  • Assist with the development of FLS code and standards analyses.
  • Provide guidance on the applicability of codes and standards to FAA facilities, its mission, and specific technical items encountered.
  • Provide FLS guidance to the FAA on program and Agency initiatives where the FLS program is a stakeholder.
  • Assist with the development of standard specifications for installations at FAA facilities.
  • Assist with FLS programmatic planning initiatives, prioritization, and consultation regarding program direction and goals.
  • FLS Condition Risk Assessments (CRA).
  • Coordination of sites with customer on specific dates, locations, impacts to the facility, etc.
  • Develop and maintain a current schedule of CRA's, at all times, with dates of visit, location, current status of CRA, team assigned, IRMC status, and other relevant information.
  • Complete, submit and maintain applicable IRMC for each project, with appropriate dates, stakeholders, approvers, etc. IRMC will be submitted no less than 30 days prior to site visit and will be approved before traveling to site.
  • Efficiently mitigate findings identified during site visits determined by the AJW-23 Program Manager as appropriate.
  • Provide additional CRA support as requested by AJW-23 Program Manager.

Senior Fire Protection Engineer Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree and 8 or more years relevant exempt experience or Masters degree and 6 or more years relevant exempt experience.
  • Professional Engineering License in Fire Protection Engineering or willingness and ability to obtain one.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in the Fire Life Safety/Fire Protection field.
  • Strong working knowledge of applicable ICC and NFPA codes.
  • Past experience developing and/or providing holistic consultation on FLS programs.
  • Ability to produce FLS designs of a variety of critical FLS elements, and be able to provide critical comments on FLS designs and installations.
  • Former experience in training FLS concepts and code application is required. experience working in a team and collaborating on issues as a peer with other Fire Protection Engineers.
  • Ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.
  • Travel up to 50% of the time to various FAA locations within this region.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineering License in Fire Protection Engineering.
  • Experience with FAA National Airspace System facilities, FAA staffed or unstaffed facilities, or similar government installations.
  • Experience with 29 CFR 1960.20.
  • Specific experience with programs at Federal agencies is preferred, with FAA experience weighted heavily.
  • Former training on the use/maintenance of Fire Protection systems.

We are seeking a candidate with a strong technical foundation and a proven ability to deliver high-quality, end-to-end AI solutions. You are passionate about tackling challenging AI problems, fostering collaboration across product and research teams, and empowering your team to build products that make a meaningful, real-world difference. This US-based role can be remote or based out of our New York City office.

AI Innovation at Dataminr

Working at Dataminr you’ll have the opportunity to tackle the most exciting trends in AI on a daily basis to power a revolutionary product that uncovers critical events around the world as they unfold.

Regenerative AI: our AI technology, ReGenAI, is a new form of generative AI that automatically regenerates real-time Live Event Briefs as events unfold. Learn more here.

Agentic AI: we recently launched our Agentic AI capability, what we’re calling our Intel Agents, that autonomously generates critical context for our clients on real-time events, threats, and risks allowing them to see the clearest, most accurate view of what’s happening on the ground. Learn more here

Multimodal AI:our platform detects events from many different types of data (images, video, sensor data, audio, and text in over 150 languages). Learn more here.

The opportunity

  • Oversee all technical aspects of how different AI models’ outputs impact the quality of content produced by our AI platform. This includes working with PMs and different parts of the business to define proper performance requirements for different Deep Learning and Machine Learning models.

  • Work closely with scientists, engineers, and product managers to drive and deliver state of the art solutions at scale in multiple areas relevant to real-time detection of events in public data sources (NLP, CV, IR, Knowledge Graphs, etc).

  • Define and track quality and cost metrics for models as well as for their integrated end-to-end performance in relation to key business goals.

  • Hands-on modification of workflows, evaluations, and outputs of models.

  • Lead other engineers and scientists, directing changes to technical approaches.

  • Excel in placing a human-centered focus on the work (context, end-user impact, etc), finding solutions that work in practice, and have significant impact.

What you bring
At Dataminr, we value you for who you are. We encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don't meet every qualification. Our candidates are reviewed on the basis of their skill and potential to succeed. 6 Bullets max

  • Strong technical background required: graduate degree in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering.

  • At least 7 years of industry experience as a software engineer in a cloud-native environment (AWS, Kubernetes).

  • At least 5 years experience leading software engineers in an AI team.

  • Experience with deep learning frameworks, LLMs, agent harnesses, compound AI systems (PyTorch, Langfuse, LangGraph, Weaviate, A2A, etc)

  • Hands-on experience in developing and deploying Machine Learning/Deep Learning/LLMs at large scale in NLP, CV, IR, or a related field, preferably in a real-time setting.

  • Demonstrated track record of driving and delivering on multiple complex AI projects.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Deep understanding of research stages, and the ability to connect multiple complex technologies in end-to-end solutions.

About Dataminr

At Dataminr, we are a mission driven team of talented builders, creators and visionaries who have real-world impact on how organizations are able to respond to events. Dataminr’s groundbreaking, AI-powered, intelligence platform provides organizations with the earliest signals of emerging risks, events, and threats before they unfold. Trusted by two-thirds of the Fortune 50 and half of the Fortune 100, Dataminr’s platform analyzes billions of public data inputs spanning text, image, video, audio and sensor data across 150+ languages, empowering our clients to stay one step ahead in an increasingly complex world where every second counts.

Founded in 2009, we have pioneered the world’s first real-time event detection platform, long before the recent Gen AI ‘boom.’ Dataminr operates all around the world united by our passion to use AI for the greater good, be agents of positive change and put our technology into the hands of clients charged with the responsibility to keep organizations running and keep people safe.

As our employees focus on developing our revolutionary technology, we focus on our employees. Dataminr is proud to offer a variety of flexible work arrangements, offices all over the world to foster collaboration, generous PTO and sick leave, and more, as part of our competitive benefits package aimed at keeping all our employees happy and healthy. Explore all our benefits here.

We believe our differences give us strength. Our employees are empowered to be their best, authentic selves through various opportunities, such as our robust employee resource group (ERG) network, manager development programming, professional development funds, and more.

We serve a global community made up of many cultures and strive to reflect the world and clients we serve, with a workforce built on merit and equity. About the Role

We are hiring a GTM Engineer to own our lead and account data pipeline end to end, keep our email sending infrastructure healthy, and build scalable GTM workflows. This person will ensure our CRM and outbound systems run on clean, enriched, deduped, and usable data, while building automations in n8n and Clay, and using tools like HubSpot, Apollo, Cognism, Lemlist, NeverBounce, and Bright Data.

This role is a mix of data hygiene, GTM engineering, email deliverability and domain management, and scraping and enrichment operations.

At Smart Working, you’ll never be just another remote hire.
Be a Smart Worker — valued, empowered, and part of a culture that celebrates integrity, excellence, and ambition.

This is a fully remote opportunity with hybrid available to those local to Boston.

Gradient AI:

Gradient AI is the decision-intelligence partner for the insurance industry, giving customers an advantage in how they make decisions by revealing risk others miss and translating it into stronger performance and real-world impact.Our platform harnesses a vast industry data lake – tens of millions of policies and claims enriched with economic, health, geographic, and demographic signals – integrating cleanly with existing workflows to make complex risk clear, usable, and actionable.Our customers include carriers, brokers, consultants, and specialized insurance organizations across the industry. We are backed by $56M in Series C funding and scaling fast – and it's an exciting time to join the team!

About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to advance our core AI models and drive them to market in collaboration with data science, product, and engineering partners. In this role, you will own well-scoped models end-to-end – working independently to ship measurable uplift on the AI capabilities at the heart of our products.

How you will make an impact:

  • Leverage the best of modern deep learning & large language models with traditional data science techniques to create powerful hybrid models with real uplift.
  • Brainstorm, prototype, prove, deploy, and realize the value of your work in market quickly.
  • Everything you would expect on a world-class data science team solving world-class problems. Big data. Federated learning. Unstructured data challenges. Timeseries and sequence modelling. A self-serve buffet of techniques from GLMs to XGBoost to Transformers.
  • Tell stories with your data. Inspire trust in customers, stakeholders, and prospects by turning murky math into a powerful message that drives the bottom line.

Who you are and why we want to work with you:

  • You like getting things over the line. You have an insatiable desire to deliver value now and improve next. MVP perfection is achieved not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away.
  • You are not a software engineer, but you give them a run for their money. You prefer Python to R and don’t understand why there is still a debate. Jupyter is a necessary evil, and you’ve never met a command line that scared you away.
  • You still do a better job than Claude, and you’re skeptical of your friends who say they never code any more.
  • You love to take initiative and spearhead new projects, even if they are not well defined.
  • You build systems bigger than you. You contribute to open source, build packages your peers want to use, or design frameworks to elevate your team. Reuse is a strategy, not a buzzword.

Skills needed to succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Biostatistics, Mathematics, or similar related field AND 3-5 years of professional data science experience building predictive models
  • OR Master’s or Ph.D in Computer Science, Data Science, Biostatistics, Mathematics, or similar related field AND 1-2 years of professional data science experience building predictive models
  • Hands-on comprehensive experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, and an understanding of modern AI architectures (e.g., Transformers, Neural Networks, LLMs). 
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and its core data science ecosystem (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, LightGBM, etc.) 
  • Strong technical communication and collaboration skills within agile squads and DS leadership
  • Familiarity with SQL, Relational databases, and cloud environments like AWS/Azure/Google/Databricks
  • MLOps and hands-on experience taking models from notebook to production — Experiment tracking, packaging, containerization (Docker), model serving and APIs, CI/CD, and pipeline orchestration

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Fluency with actuarial methods and working with actuaries is a plus 
  • Familiarity with healthcare and medical data
  • Familiarity with underwriting and claims, or predicting long-tailed and/or rare events

What We Offer:

  • A fun, team-oriented startup culture.
  • Generous stock options - we all get to own a piece of what we’re building.
  • Unlimited vacation days.
  • Flexible schedule that supports working from home.
  • Full benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, 401k, paid paternal leave, and more.
  • Ample opportunities to learn and take on new responsibilities.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

Salary Range: $135,000-165,000k base salary annually.

This role is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity grant, and a comprehensive benefits package. In accordance with the Massachusetts Pay Transparency Law, we are providing a good-faith salary range for this position at the time of posting. The actual salary offered will depend on the level at which the candidate is hired, as well as their experience, skills, qualifications, and location. Compensation may grow over time through merit-based increases, promotions, and company-wide adjustments. If your salary expectations fall outside this range, we still encourage you to apply so we can have a conversation.

This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in modern frontend frameworks, backend APIs, databases, and shipping interactive web products end-to-end.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Full-Stack Web App Developer, you'll design, build, and refine browser-based applications with real logic, state, persistence, and user input — from habit trackers and budgeting tools to internal dashboards, mini-SaaS tools, and AI-powered apps. You may also work on standalone Python applications and data-processing scripts that sit alongside or behind these products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build interactive web applications with frontend (React, Next.js, Vue, or similar) and a backend API (Python/FastAPI/Flask or Node/Express).
  • Design and implement data models, schemas, and persistence layers using SQL (PostgreSQL, SQLite) or NoSQL stores.
  • Implement authentication, sessions, and basic role-based access where needed.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and AI/LLM services (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) into product features.
  • Handle state management, user input validation, error states, and loading states cleanly.
  • Build standalone Python tools and scripts where required by the task (data processing, API clients, lightweight backend utilities).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor full-stack applications to improve correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Write clear, testable code and debug end-to-end issues across frontend, backend, and database.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in full-stack web development or shipping interactive web applications (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in full-stack web development, modern frontend frameworks, backend architecture, and building interactive browser-based applications end-to-end. We are looking for specialists who can confidently work across frontend, backend, databases, and APIs, design robust application logic, and build production-ready web applications. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently architect and ship complete features are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong command of JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, or similar).
  • Solid backend experience in Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django) and/or Node.js (Express, NestJS).
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) and basic schema design.
  • Experience implementing REST APIs, request validation, error handling, and authentication flows.
  • Familiarity with deployment platforms (Vercel, Netlify, Render, , Railway, or similar).
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or other AI services into product features is a strong plus.
  • Comfortable with version control (Git) and basic testing practices.

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to building working, robust products — not demos.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to architect, build, and ship features independently.
  • Portfolio of shipped web applications (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $60 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

raw.excerpt: DescriptionCapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients.
raw.description:
Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

raw.title: Principal Product Manager (Healthcare AI focus)
raw.excerpt: OverviewThe Principal Product Manager, AI plays an expanded strategic and executional role within the AI Product organization, responsible for owning more complex AI-enabled products or multiple product lines within Retro Claims Accuracy (RCA).
raw.description:
Overview

The Principal Product Manager, AI plays an expanded strategic and executional role within the AI Product organization, responsible for owning more complex AI-enabled products or multiple product lines within Retro Claims Accuracy (RCA). This role helps build industry-leading AI technologies that enable lines of business with cutting edge, impactful solutions, and helps accelerate the adoption of AI, including advanced ML and Generative AI techniques, at scale. The Principal Product Manager, AI leads product development, strategy, and performance while driving stronger alignment across business, technology, and customer stakeholders, and guides product ideation, execution, and validation, balancing customer needs with business objectives and measurable impact. They must lead cross-functional collaboration, influence key decisions without direct authority, and drive consensus across leadership groups to bring AI products to market and manage their lifecycle effectively. Strong leadership, communication, analytical skills, and strategic thinking are essential for success in this role, along with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, maintain a high level of technical proficiency in AI, and mentor product managers on AI product practices.

Responsibilities

  • Drive product strategy and execution, developing and delivering on the roadmap for more complex or multi-product AI initiatives, including our AI platform and solutions.
  • Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape to identify AI opportunities and create business cases for new investments, including competitive analysis, program goals, business requirements, and risk considerations.
  • Translate stakeholder and customer requirements into clear technical documentation with stronger ownership of refinement and prioritization.
  • Coordinate and partner closely with Data Science, Engineering, R&D, Enterprise Product, finance, legal, and other stakeholders with a sense of urgency in a data driven manner. Develop and drive end to end program management to define, prioritize, and implement AI features, infrastructure, processes, and workflows.
  • Drive AI technical projects from requirements through delivery, including managing complex project schedules, removing roadblocks, and keeping processes running smoothly.
  • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure AI product success and inform quarterly business reviews.
  • Lead cross-functional efforts to align business needs with AI product strategy and drive senior-level stakeholder alignment.
  • Support client engagement from pre-sales through delivery, including serving as an AI product subject matter expert in key client discussions.
  • Clearly communicate business requirements and product value to stakeholders including executives and external partners.
  • Develop and maintain a high level of technical proficiency in AI, applying process where it creates value and designing process where it’s needed.
  • Work closely with operations teams and drive AI adoption across the portfolio.
  • Provide mentorship, guidance, and day-to-day support for Product Managers and Analysts as needed.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.

Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree with a degree in business administration, marketing, computer science, engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience as a product manager driving the product development strategy and lifecycle (iterating on product roadmap and prioritizing backlog)
  • 3+ years of product management experience in AI or similar fields
  • 1+ years of experience working with AI infrastructureExperience with Healthcare IT, claims processing and data analytics domains.
  • Strong technical aptitude and familiarity with software development processes are often necessary for Product Managers, especially in technology-driven industries. Knowledge of agile development methodologies, software development life cycle (SDLC), and project management tools is highly beneficial.
  • Strong analytical skills to gather and interpret data, analyze market trends, and make informed decisions about product strategy and roadmap prioritization. Proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques is desirable.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills are essential for Product Managers to effectively communicate with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and customers. This includes the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and concisely, as well as strong presentation skills.
  • Individuals who can inspire and motivate cross-functional teams to work towards a common goal. They should be able to influence stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and drive decision-making processes effectively.
  • Experience mentoring team members or contributing to team capability development.
  • A deep understanding of customer needs, preferences, and pain points is crucial for Product Managers to develop products that meet customer expectations and deliver value. Experience with user research, customer interviews, and usability testing is beneficial.
  • Must collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer support, to ensure alignment and integration across all aspects of the product development and delivery process.
  • Understands and embodies Cotiviti Core Values, Strategic Pillars, and Operations Disciplines to achieve successful performance in completing assigned responsibilities and interactions with the Organization both internally and externally.

Mental Requirements:

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: be comfortable taking calculated risks, experimenting with new ideas, and iterating on products based on feedback and market validation.
  • Strategic Thinking & Execution: ability to develop and execute a comprehensive product strategy aligned with the company's overall goals and objectives. They should be able to anticipate market trends and identify opportunities for product innovation and growth.
  • Stress Management: should have effective stress management techniques to stay calm under pressure and maintain productivity.
  • Adaptability: need to be adaptable and flexible, capable of adjusting plans and strategies in response to evolving circumstances while maintaining focus on project objectives.
  • Resilience: ability to bounce back from disappointments, learn from mistakes, and continue driving the product forward with determination and optimism.
  • Attention to Detail: must pay close attention to detail to ensure that all project requirements are met, deliverables are of high quality, and risks are adequately addressed.
  • Time Management: skilled at organizing their own time and the time of their team members to maximize efficiency and productivity.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Travel as assigned by Leadership (10 -15%).
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Moving (carrying, lifting, pushing, etc.) equipment weighing up to 10 lbs. for presentations set up, etc.
  • Exposure to moderate noise intensity is expected.
  • No adverse environmental conditions are expected.

Base compensation ranges from $140,000 to $180,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Date of posting: 8/4/2026

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 9/4/2026 but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

raw.description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

At Veeam, Solutions Architects work closely with sales providing solutions to problems. As well as helping to evangelize our product offerings to our partners, resellers and end users, they provide a subject matter level of expertise and engage with opportunities at a deeper level to ensure pre-sales and post-sales success.

What You’ll Do

  • Engage with sales teams in supporting sales opportunities from pre-sales through post-sales relationships
  • Provide architectural designs and engage in large scale proof of concepts, technical alliance validations, and post-sales deployments supporting Veeam service delivery partners
  • Provide subject matter expertise in the Veeam product suites to customers, partners, and internal Veeam teams
  • Develop whitepapers, best practice guides, competitive analysis documentation, and compete strategies as required to support deployment engagements and sales opportunities
  • Be an active contributor in the Veeam Community Forums
  • Attend marketing and technical presentations representing Veeam at a subject matter expert level

What You’ll Bring

  • Deep experience with hypervisor technologies from multiple vendors including Vmware, Microsoft and RedHat.
  • Hands on experience of large and complex datacenter infrastructure operations
  • Experience and understanding of the top three Hyperscalers (AWS, Azure and Google Cloud)
  • Experience with relational database software.
  • Experience with programming/scripting language for automation
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Be comfortable presenting to groups, both on the phone and in person
  • Be available to travel within the assigned region as directed
  • Be a self-starter with the ability to learn new technologies quickly
  • Possess project management skills
  • Demonstrated expert capabilities in focused solutions
  • Demonstrated logical mindset and problem solving skills
  • Fluent English speaker

What You’ll Get

  • 30 paid vacation days, plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Monthly employer-paid allowance for private healthcare
  • Monthly private pension allowance based on base salary
  • Mandatory workers’ compensation and injury insurance
  • Employer contributions to Danish social security schemes (including ATP, AUB, AES, AFU, maternity leave fund, and more)
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Please note: If an applicant is permanently located outside of Denmark, Veeam reserves the right to decline the application for this position.

All your information will be kept confidential.

Personal data collected during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Notice, which explains how your information is collected, used, and handled in connection with hiring activities. By applying for this position, you consent to this processing.

By submitting your application, you confirm that the information provided, including any supporting documents, is complete and accurate to the best of your knowledge. Any misrepresentation, omission, or falsification may result in disqualification from consideration or, if discovered after employment begins, termination of employment.

raw.description:
Job Description:

Account Executive, WineSuite

Wine and spirits retailers across the United States run their stores on our software: point of sale, inventory, purchasing, e-commerce, and reporting, all built specifically for their industry. As an Account Executive, you own the full sales cycle for our flagship products, WinePOS, WineCommerce and WinePayments, from finding the right prospects to closing the deal.

This is a full-cycle B2B sales role for a self-starter who can build a pipeline, run a compelling demo, and win the business. You will report to the VP of Sales and Marketing.

What you'll do

  • Build pipeline. Generate new business through cold calling, direct outreach, referrals, and creative prospecting, both traditional and non-traditional.

  • Qualify and prioritize. Identify strong-fit prospects for WinePOS and WineCommerce, and disqualify the ones that aren't, so your time goes where it counts.

  • Demo the product. Present and demonstrate our solutions in person and remotely, tailoring each conversation to the prospect's specific needs.

  • Close. Understand each prospect's system requirements, position the right solution, and win the business.

  • Set up a clean handoff. Capture the core account details the Implementation Team needs to take it from there.

  • Represent the brand. Be a visible ambassador for WinePOS at industry events and meetings.

What we're looking for

  • 3 to 5 years of full-cycle software sales, with a track record of turning leads into closed deals across both new prospects and warm referrals.

  • Strong presentation and prospecting skills, and the ability to explain intangible services and solutions clearly to a range of audiences.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and comfort in both formal and informal settings.

  • A genuine self-starter who learns fast, works independently, and finishes what they start.

  • A consultative listener who can accurately restate a prospect's needs and negotiate well when interests differ.

What will set you apart

  • Experience selling or supporting POS and/or e-commerce solutions.

  • Experience in the wine, spirits, or wider liquor industry.

  • Training in a structured sales methodology such as Sandler, SPIN, MEDDPICC, or Challenger.

Compensation and benefits

  • On-target earnings (OTE): $130,000 to $160,000 CAD, made up of base salary plus monthly commission on your sales, depending on experience and qualifications.

  • Health, Dental, and Supplemental Insurance.

  • Paid time off and vacation.

Work arrangement: Remote-first within Canada or the United States, with occasional on-site presence at our New Jersey office for events and training, plus approximately 10% travel within the US.

About ICS

For over 40 years, ICS has served the retail beverage alcohol industry as a trusted, scalable solutions provider. Our core product, WinePOS, delivers point of sale, inventory, purchasing, and reporting to wine and liquor retailers across the United States, complemented by WineCommerce for online sales and WinePayments for integrated payments. ICS is an operating unit of Jonas Software.

That focus is your advantage: WinePOS is one of the few point-of-sale platforms built specifically for wine and spirits retail, so you sell on fit and expertise, not on price against generic systems. You get the backing and resources of Jonas Software with the focus of a specialized team, where your results are visible and rewarded.

How to apply

Submit your resume through the application link. We would love to get back to everyone, but we only reach out to the candidates we would like to move forward with. If that is you, we will be in touch.

AI is used to help screen and assess applications for this role. A human always makes the final hiring decision.

Business Unit:

Innovative Computer Solutions Inc

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

37.5

Number of Openings Available:

1

Worker Type:

Regular

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Founded in 2020, Lavender is the largest nurse-owned and operated online psychiatry and therapy office in the United States. Our extraordinary team of 100+ talented and like-minded folks works remotely from across the United States, Canada and the Philippines to collaboratively increase access to high-quality, high-touch mental healthcare.   • Be part of a company that is truly making a difference in the world

raw.description:
At OneStudyTeam (a Reify Health company), we specialize in speeding up clinical trials and increasing the chance of new therapies being approved with the ultimate goal of improving patient outcomes. Our cloud-based platform, StudyTeam, brings research site workflows online and enables sites, sponsors, and other key stakeholders to work together more effectively. StudyTeam is trusted by the largest global biopharmaceutical companies, used in over 6,000 research sites, and is available in over 100 countries. Join us in our mission to advance clinical research and improve patient care.

One mission. One team. That’s OneStudyTeam.

As the Director of Engineering, you are someone who deeply cares about your team and the success of those around you. You are an experienced leader and manager with a strong background in SaaS based product organizations and you were once a developer yourself. You can hold your own in technical conversations, thoughdon't need to write software. You are an energetic person with a passion to learn and can quickly and effectively take those learnings and apply them to their work. You take a servant leadership approach to management waking up every day to improve the experiences of your team and the organization. You shine as a collaborator and are an impeccable communicator.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Delivery & Roadmap Execution: Own the tactical execution of the engineering roadmap. Partner with Product and Design to break down product requirements into clear milestones, ensuring the team consistently ships high-quality software on time.
  • Hands-on Architectural Guidance: Unblock engineering teams by participating in technical design reviews. Ensure the team builds a stable, scalable platform that successfully ingests and processes complex clinical trial data sources without technical debt.
  • Feature & Tooling Implementation: Drive the day-to-day development of predictive models and analytics tools. Work directly with data and software engineers to ensure these tools accurately surface trial bottlenecks and function reliably for end-user
  • Sprint & Resource Management: Manage sprint capacity, budget tracking, and day-to-day resource allocation. Balance technical debt with feature delivery to maximize engineering velocity and keep data collection timelines on track.
  • Agile Process Optimization: Run, refine, and optimize the agile ceremonies and development workflows within your department. Identify and eliminate operational friction to improve the team's daily shipping cadence.
  • Line Management & Career Mentorship: Manage Engineering Managers and Tech Leads directly. Conduct regular 1-on-1s, deliver performance reviews, write career growth plans, and actively interview and onboard new engineering hires.
  • Team Health & Collaboration: Maintain a high-performing, inclusive team culture. Resolve interpersonal or cross-team friction and ensure clear communication boundaries between engineering squads.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for project stakeholders. Translate technical blockers, updates, and risks into clear operational timelines for non-technical partners.

What You Bring to OneStudyTeam

  • Minimum Education
    • BA or BS degree from college or university.
  • Minimum Experience
    • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years successfully managing engineering teams.
  • Proven experience as a "manager of managers," directly leading and developing Engineering Managers and Technical Leads.
  • Track record of owning the execution and on-time delivery of complex, data-heavy software products and platforms.
  • Strong technical background in scalable architecture, cloud infrastructure, and handling complex data pipelines or predictive models.
  • Deep operational expertise in Agile/Scrum methodologies, sprint capacity planning, and continuous integration/delivery (CI/CD) workflows.
  • Ability to actively participate in and guide technical design reviews, ensuring platform stability and minimal technical debt.
  • Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to translate technical blockers and project risks for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience fostering a high-accountability, collaborative team culture that maintains high morale during rapid growth.
  • Prior experience working within HealthTech, Biotech, or the Clinical Trials/Life Sciences industry is highly preferred.

The expected pay range for this role is $180,000 - $230,000 USD per year for full time team members.

We value diversity and believe the unique contributions each of us brings drives our success. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

raw.description:
Job Description

Momentive Software is seeking a Tax Manager to join its Tax Department. This role owns U.S. sales and uses tax compliance and Canadian GST/HST compliance end-to-end, reviews VAT/GST filings prepared by third parties or local teams across the company's international jurisdictions and provides general administrative support to the Tax Department. The role reports to the Vice President of Tax and requires strong technical indirect tax knowledge, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple compliance deadlines independently.


Key Responsibilities


U.S. Sales & Use Tax

  • Prepare, review, and timely file U.S. sales and use tax returns across the company’s multi-state nexus footprint.
  • Maintain the sales tax compliance calendar, coordinate payments, and perform related account reconciliations.
  • Research and resolve state and local sales tax notices, inquiries, and audits.
  • Maintain and update taxability matrices, nexus determinations, and customer exemption certificates.
  • Partner with Billing, AR, and IT teams on tax coding, invoicing setup, and tax engine configuration (e.g., Avalara, Vertex).
  • Monitor U.S. state and local indirect tax law changes and assess business impact.

Canadian GST/HST

  • Prepare and file Canadian federal and provincial indirect tax returns (GST/HST, QST, and similar).
  • Reconcile GST/HST payable and receivable accounts on a recurring basis.
  • Respond to CRA and provincial tax authority inquiries and manage related documentation and audits.

VAT/GST Review – International Jurisdictions

  • Review VAT/GST returns prepared by outsourced providers or local finance teams across EMEA, APAC, and other applicable jurisdictions prior to filing.
  • Identify discrepancies, follow up with preparers, and ensure timely, accurate submission.
  • Monitor changes in international VAT/GST rates and regulations that affect the business.
  • Support VAT/GST registrations, de-registrations, and maintenance of the global compliance calendar.

Corporate Income Tax Development and Support

  • Demonstrate an interest in learning and supporting U.S. and international corporate income tax matters.
  • Assist with corporate income tax compliance, tax provision processes, and related projects as needed.
  • Support tax planning initiatives, legal entity restructuring projects, and tax research assignments under supervision.
  • Participate in cross-functional tax initiatives to broaden overall tax expertise.

Administrative & General Support

  • Assist with indirect tax audits, government information requests, and related documentation.
  • Maintain organized tax department files, workpapers, and process documentation.
  • Support process improvement and automation initiatives within the indirect tax function.
  • Perform other administrative and ad hoc duties as assigned by the Vice President of Tax.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Progressive experience in indirect tax required, with hands-on U.S. sales and use tax compliance experience; Canadian GST/HST and/or international VAT/GST experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience with sales tax compliance/automation software (e.g., Avalara, Vertex, OneSource) preferred.
  • Strong Excel skills; experience with an ERP system (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) a plus.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple filing deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work with cross-functional teams and external advisors.
  • CPA, CMI, or progress toward a relevant certification is a plus.

Working Relationships

This role works closely with the VP of Tax and broader Tax Department, as well as Accounting, Billing, AR, Legal, and IT teams, and interfaces with external tax advisors and government tax authorities.

About Us

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com.

Why Work Here?

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here.

Overview

The Implementation Consultant is a post-sales position focused on individual clients and the implementation of Edifecs solutions they have purchased. This role involves installing, configuring, and overseeing the implementation of Edifecs products for the client. Responsibilities include installing products on Edifecs or client hardware, and configuring and developing programs, tasks, and guidelines to fully implement Edifecs solutions based on the client's specific needs. The Implementation Consultant will serve as the primary technical resource for Client Services, interfacing with the client's technical resources. Duties range from delivering product training to developing and deploying new client-specific requirements. This role requires strong client coordination and communication skills, as well as a deep technical understanding of Edifecs solutions and the transactions they handle.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and communicate with the client post-sale to develop an implementation plan for configuring a purchased Edifecs solution based on the client’s individual needs.
  • Collaborate with the Edifecs Implementation Architect/Technical Project Manager to formulate the architecture, implementation strategy/schedule, and operational plan.
  • Install, upgrade, and configure Edifecs products for the client.
  • Integrate Edifecs products with other software assets/processes for the client.
  • Coordinate with other Client Services, Product, and Development team members to meet development and configuration milestones, developing guidelines, programs, tasks, reports, etc., to meet the client’s requirements.
  • Provide post-implementation support during the transition from implementation to maintenance.
  • Provide software and client-specific training, and develop training documentation based on current standards and client needs.
  • Mentor and train internal teams on Edifecs products and customer custom components.

raw.title: Director, Analytics & Insights
raw.excerpt: 💈 WHO WE ARESQUIRE is the leading business management system designed for the needs of barbers, shop owners, and their communities.
raw.description:
💈 WHO WE ARE

SQUIRE is the leading business management system designed for the needs of barbers, shop owners, and their communities. We believe the pursuit of artistry and autonomy should not be restricted by the complexities of running a business. With SQUIRE, we provide custom-branded tools, resources, and guidance to help barbers of all stages and experience levels attract and retain more customers, efficiently manage their shop operations, and increase their revenue.
Founded in 2015, SQUIRE is trusted by more than 30,000 barbers across 5,000+ shops in more than a thousand cities worldwide. From streamlined booking and opening new shops to real-time earning dashboards and building lasting customer relationships, SQUIRE supports shop owners in seamlessly bridging the gap between their personal craft and business goals. SQUIRE enables barbers everywhere to unlock their full potential both as artists and as entrepreneurs.
For more information, please visit or download the SQUIRE app from the App or Play Store.

🎯 ABOUT THE ROLE

    As SQUIRE continues to grow, so does the need for clean, well-defined, and trustworthy data on how the business is performing. As the Director, Analytics & Insights, you will define the standards, taxonomies, and requirements in our core source systems needed for data to flow and report information properly for the business. Based on the data captured, you will consolidate and uncover the drivers behind churn, retention, and conversion, then apply that same rigor to product telemetry and marketing analytics, and bring those insights directly to the leaders who can act on them.

    Success in this role means the company operates from one consistent and trusted set of metrics built on quality source system data, with leaders able to approach important decisions with a clear understanding of the factors behind them. Your work will directly influence business outcomes with a clear understanding of what matters most, rather than simply report on them. As SQUIRE expands its use of AI, you will bring a thoughtful perspective on where it can add the most value in analytics and ensure our data is prepared to support that work. This role, above all, is central to how SQUIRE makes informed decisions to move faster and scale with confidence.

    Reports To: SVP, Operations
    Location: Remote - US or Canada
    Type: Full-Time
    Compensation: Base ($200,000 - $230,000) + Bonus (15%)

🧰 YOUR CRAFT (Job Duties & Responsibilities)

  • Proactively analyze business performance to identify what is changing and why across churn, retention, conversion, unit economics, funnel performance, product adoption, product telemetry, and marketing analytics
  • Translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations for the leaders and teams positioned to act on them
  • Define and lead the multi-year strategy for SQUIRE’s analytical data, including how it is modeled, structured, and governed to support accurate analysis for scalable business growth and future AI capabilities
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering (which is responsible for the underlying data platform and infrastructure) to develop scalable and reliable analytical models
  • Set the strategy for AI-driven analytics, keep our data clean and AI-ready to power both the AI we build into our product and the AI we use to scale the team, from automating first-pass reporting to building on the AI data assistant already in place
  • Lead Looker as SQUIRE's primary business intelligence platform, including dashboard strategy, reporting improvements, platform cleanup, and self-service reporting
  • Establish the metric definitions, quality standards, and governance practices needed to maintain trust in the company's data as the business grows in scale and complexity
  • Lead the company's OKR process and performance readouts, including the cadence, measurement, and reporting used to create visibility and accountability
  • Lead and grow the analytics function by hiring and developing a team known for quality and reliability across analytics engineering, business intelligence, and analysis

    • The duties and responsibilities outlined above are not a comprehensive list, and additional tasks may be assigned from time to time based on business needs.

⚙️ YOUR FOUNDATION (Experience & Skills)

  • 10+ years of experience in an analytics or data function, including 4+ years of people management, with a track record of setting strategy, building analytical data models, and developing teams beyond day-to-day reporting
  • Demonstrated experience translating data into insights that influence leadership decisions and measurable business outcomes
  • Experience building analytical models, systems, and practices that create lasting organizational value beyond individual dashboards
  • Technical fluency across SQL, data modeling, statistics fundamentals, dbt or similar transformation tools, and Looker
  • Technical judgment and hands-on experience to guide how analytical data is structured and maintain consistent definitions across the business
  • Thoughtful and clear perspective on AI in analytics, including where it can add meaningful value and where human judgment remains essential
  • Genuine curiosity about the business, with the ability to move from understanding why something happened to identifying why it matters and what should happen next
  • Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to develop a team and translate complex analytical concepts for executive audiences

✂️ EXTRA CUT (Nice to Haves)

  • Experience within a multi-product, marketplace with direct and secondary customers, or SaaS business during a period of scaling or expansion into new verticals, particularly in Salesforce- and Snowflake-based environments.
  • Experience partnering closely with a Data Engineering function on data platforms and infrastructure without having directly led the infrastructure function.

    • Don’t let this list stop you from applying - If you are interested in the role, we’d love to hear from you!

🚀 WHY SQUIRE?

    This is the first role of its kind at SQUIRE and an opportunity to shape how the entire company understands and uses its data. You will lead the Analytics & Insights function, establish the trusted metrics that teams and leaders rely on, and define how data and AI can become lasting assets for the business. By partnering directly with company leaders on the decisions shaping SQUIRE's future, you will play a central role in how the company measures performance, identifies opportunities, moves faster, and scales with confidence.

🎁 WHAT WE OFFER

  • Base Salary ($200,000 - $230,000) + Bonus (15%)
  • New hire stock grant
  • 100% employer-paid medical/dental/vision insurance for you and your dependents
  • 401K plan with company contribution
  • Generous PTO and Parental Leave policies
Interview Accommodations
SQUIRE is committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to and someone on our team will respond to your request.
Equal Employment Opportunity
SQUIRE provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.
Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision
SQUIRE will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information.

raw.description:
About Us

Hydrafacial is a global category-creating company focused on bringing innovative products to market and delivering beauty health experiences by reinventing our consumer’s relationship with their skin, their bodies and their self-confidence.

Every person here is a key player in our success. We are firm believers in making the little things count each day so the big things will follow. If this sounds like you, come check us out! This is the perfect opportunity to work with some of the best leaders in the industry while you gain the global and strategic experience to add to your professional toolbox.

Job Description:

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Not every provider account needs a field visit to grow — and the Inside Business Development Manager is the person who proves it. Working virtually across a defined territory of Hydrafacial provider accounts, the IBDM drives consumable revenue, improves utilization, and reactivates underperforming accounts through strategic virtual engagement, data-driven business planning, and expert clinical guidance. This role is a critical complement to the field commercial team, ensuring that no account is left without a growth strategy.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Strategically manage a defined territory of provider accounts for Hydrafacial and the full SkinHealth Systems treatment platform, driving growth in consumable sales, treatment utilization, and device loyalty through primarily virtual engagement.

  • Develop and execute individualized business plans for each account focused on patient acquisition, treatment menu optimization, ROI improvement, and booster penetration.

  • Analyze account performance data to identify gaps and opportunities — including underperforming accounts, upgrade candidates, and trade-up opportunities.

  • Deliver consistent virtual training and onboarding for new estheticians and provider staff, covering treatment protocols, booster education, and front desk sales enablement.

  • Provide full practice support including consultation strategy, treatment planning, patient experience optimization, and in-practice operational guidance.

  • Guide Silver Circle (underperforming) accounts through reactivation strategies, providing targeted business support to restore utilization and revenue.

  • Support capital lead generation, qualification, and follow-up in close partnership with the Capital Sales Manager.

  • Educate clients on loyalty programs, the My Beauty Health App, and the online ordering platform to improve operational efficiency and retention.

  • Partner daily with Capital Sales Managers, Regional Training Specialists, and field Business Development Managers to execute regional strategies and ensure seamless account coverage.

  • Attend required company meetings, including Global Sales, Mid-Year/Regional meetings, and special events as needed.

  • Maintain thorough daily documentation of all customer interactions, business plans, and account updates in Salesforce.

  • Work Pacific Standard Time

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Required

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • Demonstrated ability to build and execute business development or account management strategies that drive measurable client growth.

  • Experience working directly with medical practices or med-spas to increase patient volume and revenue.

  • Experience delivering virtual training or providing remote account support.

  • Prior experience in a strategic sales, territory management, or key account role.

  • Strong business acumen with understanding of pricing strategy, menu development, and ROI communication.

  • Proven success in consultative sales, upselling, and client relationship management.

  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and virtual collaboration tools.

  • Excellent communication, planning, and organizational skills.

  • Willingness to attend company events and meetings requiring occasional travel.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.

  • Aesthetic license or familiarity with the skincare or medical aesthetics industry.

  • Experience with Salesforce CRM.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS OF THE JOB

  • Primarily office or home-office based role; prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer or phone for up to 8 hours per day.

  • Ability to use a computer, keyboard, and video conferencing tools for extended periods; good visual acuity and manual dexterity required.

  • Occasional travel by car or plane for company meetings, trade shows, and regional events — approximately 10–20% annually.

  • Must be able to carry presentation materials and a laptop weighing up to 40 lbs.

We mean it when we say you’ll LOVE this role.

Base Pay: $30.00/hour + commission

What else can you expect with Hydrafacial?
PERKS! Benefits include: Medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, FSAs, HSAs, accident insurance, pet insurance, company-paid life and AD&D insurance, company-paid long-term and short-term disability insurance, 401(k) with employer match, paid time off (PTO), and paid holidays.

An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, travel requirements, revenue-based metrics, any contractual agreements, and business or organizational needs. The range listed is just one component of Hydrafacial's total rewards package for our employees. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, long-term incentives based on level, paid time off, and region-specific benefits. Come grow and GLOW with us!

Hydrafacial is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, gender identity, gender expression, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy or any other protected characteristic as outlined by color, federal, state or local laws. We are committed to working with and providing accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities.

Hydrafacial does not accept unsolicited assistance or resumes/CVs from third party search firms. No fee will be paid in the event a candidate is hired by our company as a result of an agency referral or CV/resume submitted by a search firm to any employee at our company without a valid written search agreement. If we need additional support, we will be sure to reach out directly to one of our preferred providers.Please no phone calls or emails.
